name: OsTIrus
description: Access Virus TI emulator (Gearmulator OsTIrus): TI, TI2 and Snow from one firmware, with the factory banks it carries
author: dsp56300/gearmulator (Pung module: rgeissen)

assets.label: Firmware
assets.description: Requires an Access Virus TI firmware: the .bin file of the firmware installer (about 8 MB). It holds the TI, the TI2 and the Snow, and their factory sounds. The loader finds it by content, so the name is free.
assets.hint: The emulator runs the Virus's two DSPs on its own threads, off the audio thread. One OsTIrus at a time.
